decision: Capturing bounded native metadata is feasible. A minimal dtype/device/layout summary fits the demonstrated envelopes; full moments plus exact shape profiles do not fit the illustrated 3072B envelope alongside existing options without further measured serialization design. Do not expand caps or force visibility.

minimum_scope.optimizer_types: Exact cached native SGD/Adam/AdamW classes only; custom subclasses/unknown implementations unsupported for this optional component
minimum_scope.parameter_identity: Only already-catalogued live weak Parameter identities; never call the identity-creation helper or retain tensors strongly
minimum_scope.tensor_types: Exact native Tensor/Parameter on CPU/CUDA, strided, concrete bounded integer dimensions; custom/subclass/sparse/meta/symbolic/unknown backend or unsupported dispatch cases stay unknown
minimum_scope.mapping_types: Exact built-in instance dict, parameter group dict/list and native state dict/defaultdict; use fixed-key get with sentinel, never self.state[p] or state_dict()
minimum_scope.unknown_objects: No traversal, repr, value conversion or copying arbitrary state/custom objects; unknown keys counted without copying their names or contents

temporal_contract.facts: Actual group parameter tensor metadata and state entries already present at that instant only
temporal_contract.does_not_prove: custom subclass completion, loaded state after return, first update, or later moment existence

temporal_contract.facts: Actual parameter/state metadata before the native call
temporal_contract.does_not_prove: lazy state that will be allocated inside that call; closure/custom code future effects

temporal_contract.facts: Actual metadata after native optimizer call returns; sample before host logical-update/step-limit code can raise
temporal_contract.does_not_prove: state values, scalar step-counter value, numerical equivalence or persistent truth between sampled boundaries

temporal_contract.facts: No successful-post observation exists; preserve the last pre observation and explicit unmatched post unknown
temporal_contract.does_not_prove: state remained absent or unchanged during the failed call

presence_contract: state dict present but known key absent
known key contains supported native tensor metadata

compression_and_caps.raw_envelope_scope: shared options+tensor/state optional metadata, not a new second 64KiB allowance
compression_and_caps.dedup: Canonical metadata-signature profiles and bounded parameter-ID sets; stage/state-profile observations reference only proven exact sets. No signature profile is a tensor identity or proof of shared storage.
compression_and_caps.coverage: Any unsupported tensor, unknown option/state type, unknown member, changed profile beyond capacity, metadata error or byte cap sets this optional component incomplete. Never alter original update or numeric coverage.
compression_and_caps.context: Preserve all legacy observed facts first. Add optional metadata only if combined context fits; otherwise omit it explicitly as unknown. Do not infer that raw data is model-visible.
compression_and_caps.bytes_semantics: logical bytes per tensor/field only; no unique storage, alias, allocated CUDA bytes or additional saving estimate is proven. Do not sum repeated profile references as physical allocation.

source_binding: Apply the existing selected Lab run ID and exact retained source SHA gate before any model-visible summary; temporal metadata is scoped to that selected capture only
legacy_contract: No optimizer tensor/state metadata exists in R15 raw captures. Return not_captured for those fields; preserve existing status/observations exactly, never fabricate historical states or shapes.
recommended_order_if_R16_shows_real_bloc: First consider only native parameter dtype/device/layout coverage, which addresses the narrow s8 question at lower risk and fits shown size examples.
Add native state observations only if an actual R16 blocker requires them and the source-supported strategy genuinely depends on them.
Before any implementation, prove a compact state/shape representation fits the existing combined cap; if it does not, leave the blocker explicit rather than reduce old evidence or raise limits.
genuine_unknowns_not_solved: state tensor values and step-counter values
